content: Gaming optimization tools commonly expose Win32PrioritySeparation (CPU scheduling/quantum), SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB (service host memory splitting), Game Mode toggles, and network/latency tweaks. Community consensus: these registry tweaks are largely placebo on modern hardware relative to driver/engine/power-plan factors, but remain popular 'ritual' tweaks; dedicated small utilities exist just to toggle Win32PrioritySeparation.
